title: Abysslink evidence-bundle manifest (v1)
description: JSON Schema for manifest.json, the signed head of an .alevidence bundle produced by `abysslink audit evidence` (and the object emitted by `abysslink audit evidence --json`). This is the ingest contract the future Teams/aggregation plane consumes. The manifest is an OPERATOR ATTESTATION signed with the rig's ed25519 evidence key: it states, over a signed byte range, the audit-chain verification outcome the operator's abysslink computed (which requires the secret HMAC key an external auditor does not hold). A valid signature over an unexpected `signing.key_fingerprint` is still internally valid — the out-of-band fingerprint pin is the trust anchor. This schema mirrors internal/evidence.Manifest exactly; drift is a bug (see internal/evidence/schema_test.go).

alevidence_v.description: Bundle format version. Bumped only for append-only-incompatible manifest changes; a new major version ships as a new alevidence-vN.schema.json.

generated_at.description: When the bundle was produced, RFC3339 in UTC (e.g. 2026-07-09T12:00:00Z).

rig.description: Identifies the machine the evidence came from.

abysslink_version.description: Version of the abysslink binary that produced the bundle.

range.description: The [since, until] window the bundle covers. Both bounds are optional; an absent bound means an open end (full history on that side).

since.description: Only include actions at/after this RFC3339 UTC time. Omitted when open-ended.

until.description: Only include actions at/before this RFC3339 UTC time. Omitted when open-ended.

chain.description: The operator's abysslink attesting the audit-chain verification outcome — the part an external auditor cannot recompute without the secret HMAC key. Signed, so the attestation is bound to the evidence key.

verified.description: True only when the chain verified OK AND no truncation was detected AND the result is not indeterminate.

entry_count.description: Number of audit entries in the bundled audit.jsonl.

sigs_verified.description: Count of entries whose per-entry HMAC signature verified.

sigs_skipped.description: Count of entries whose signature could not be checked (e.g. pre-signing legacy entries).

key_epoch.description: The audit key epoch at generation time (uint32).

counter_status.description: AUD-02 keychain monotonic-counter check (honest tri-state, never coerced to PASS): 'verified' counter matches entry count; 'unknown' counter unavailable/degraded; 'mismatch' counter exceeds entries (genuine tail truncation); '' a pre-AUD-02 log with no counter.

truncation_detected.description: True when tail truncation of the audit log was detected.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation when the chain did not fully verify. Omitted on a clean result.

contents.description: Pins the SHA-256 of every other file in the bundle; the signature over this manifest transitively covers those files.

audit_jsonl_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bundled audit.jsonl.

report_md_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bundled report.md.

signing.description: Describes the ed25519 key that signed the manifest. The verifier checks the signature with public_key; the auditor pins key_fingerprint out-of-band (SSH-host-key trust model).

algo.description: Signature algorithm; only ed25519 is defined for v1.

public_key.description: Standard base64 of the 32-byte ed25519 public key (44 chars).

key_fingerprint.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the ed25519 public key — the value the operator states out-of-band and the auditor pins with `--expect-key`.
